company.name: Squatty Potty
company.one_liner: A toilet stool that puts your body in a more natural position.

facts.summary: A mother-and-son company selling a simple stool that sits around the toilet base and raises your feet, which they say improves posture in the bathroom.
highlights: The product is simple and cheap to manufacture.
Sales are already strong, mainly online, and the business is profitable.
The category is embarrassing to talk about, so marketing needs humor.
They want a partner to get into big-box retail.

outcome.headline: A viral ad and retail push, then sold to Aterian for ~$31M.
outcome.story: Squatty Potty landed in major retailers and made a famously viral unicorn ad. In May 2021 its assets were bought by Aterian for about $30.8M in total consideration (cash, inventory, earnout and transition services).
